title.en: Book of Wei, Chapter 18 · Biography of Li Tong

text.en: Li Tong and Chen Gong, fellow commandery natives, jointly raised troops at Langling, rallying many followers to their cause.
text.zht: 李通與同郡陳恭在朗陵共同起兵，眾人紛紛歸附。
text.zhs: 李通与同郡陈恭在朗陵共同起兵，众人纷纷归附。

text.en: Though outwardly friendly, Li Tong and Zhou Zhi were secretly at odds; Li Tong invited Zhou Zhi to a feast and killed him once he was drunk.
text.zht: 李通與周直表面交好，實則暗中不合；李通設宴邀請周直，待其酒醉後將其殺害。
text.zhs: 李通与周直表面交好，实则暗中不合；李通设宴邀请周直，待其酒醉后将其杀害。

text.en: Though outwardly friendly, Chen Gong was secretly at odds with Zhou Zhi, though he lacked the resolve to act against him.
text.zht: 陳恭與周直表面交好，實則暗中不合，然無決斷之力對付他。
text.zhs: 陈恭与周直表面交好，实则暗中不合，然无决断之力对付他。

text.en: Chen He was Chen Gong's brother-in-law; after murdering Chen Gong and seizing his followers, he was defeated and killed by Li Tong.
text.zht: 陳郃是陳恭的姊夫；他殺害陳恭並奪其部眾後，為李通所擊敗誅殺。
text.zhs: 陈郃是陈恭的姊夫；他杀害陈恭并夺其部众后，为李通所击败诛杀。

text.en: After Chen He murdered Chen Gong and seized his followers, Li Tong defeated and killed him, offering his head in sacrifice at Chen Gong's tomb.
text.zht: 陳郃殺害陳恭並奪其部眾後，李通將他擊敗誅殺，並以其首級祭奠陳恭之墓。
text.zhs: 陈郃杀害陈恭并夺其部众后，李通将他击败诛杀，并以其首级祭奠陈恭之墓。

text.en: Li Tong captured the Yellow Turban commander Wu Ba alive and persuaded his followers to surrender.
text.zht: 李通生擒黃巾軍首領吳霸，並勸降其部眾。
text.zhs: 李通生擒黄巾军首领吴霸，并劝降其部众。

text.en: At the start of the Jian'an era, Li Tong led his followers to join Cao Cao at Xuchang; after leading the front assault that defeated Zhang Xiu's army, he was promoted from Gentleman-General Who Rallies Might to Assistant General, enfeoffed Marquis Jianggong, and made Commandant of Yang'an.
text.zht: 建安初，李通率眾於許都投奔曹操，先拜振威中郎將；後於擊破張繡軍一役中為先登，升任裨將軍，封建功侯，任陽安都尉。
text.zhs: 建安初，李通率众于许都投奔曹操，先拜振威中郎将；后于击破张绣军一役中为先登，升任裨将军，封建功侯，任阳安都尉。

title.en: Gentleman-General Who Rallies Might; later Assistant General, Marquis Jianggong, Commandant of Yang'an
title.zht: 振威中郎將；後裨將軍、建功侯、陽安都尉
title.zhs: 振威中郎将；后裨将军、建功侯、阳安都尉

text.en: When Yuan Shao and Liu Biao both tried to win him over, Li Tong refused both, declaring he would rather die than betray his allegiance, executed Yuan Shao's envoy, and defeated the local rebels Qu Gong, Jiang Gong, and Shen Cheng, pacifying the Huai and Ru regions; he was then enfeoffed Capital Neighbourhood Marquis and made Grand Administrator of Runan.
text.zht: 袁紹、劉表皆欲招攬李通，李通悉數拒絕，誓以死不貳，並斬殺袁紹使者，又擊破郡賊瞿恭、江宮、沈成等，平定淮、汝之地；遂改封都亭侯，拜汝南太守。
text.zhs: 袁绍、刘表皆欲招揽李通，李通悉数拒绝，誓以死不贰，并斩杀袁绍使者，又击破郡贼瞿恭、江宫、沈成等，平定淮、汝之地；遂改封都亭侯，拜汝南太守。

title.en: Capital Neighbourhood Marquis, Grand Administrator of Runan

text.en: After breaking through the encirclement to relieve Cao Ren at Jiangling, Li Tong fell ill on the march and died at forty-two; Cao Pi posthumously honoured him as Marquis Gang and commended his unwavering loyalty during the Yuan Shao crisis, appointing his sons Li Ji and Li Xu as Gentleman-Generals in recognition of the family's service.
text.zht: 李通突圍解江陵之圍後，於行軍途中病逝，年四十二；文帝追諡剛侯，嘉許他在袁紹之難中秉義不貳，並拜其子李基、李緒為中郎將，以彰其家世代功勳。
text.zhs: 李通突围解江陵之围后，于行军途中病逝，年四十二；文帝追谥刚侯，嘉许他在袁绍之难中秉义不贰，并拜其子李基、李绪为中郎将，以彰其家世代功勋。

text.en: When Cao Cao campaigned against Zhang Xiu, Li Tong led the front assault and swiftly defeated his army.
text.zht: 曹操征討張繡時，李通為先登，迅速擊破其軍。
text.zhs: 曹操征讨张绣时，李通为先登，迅速击破其军。

text.en: Liu Biao sent troops to reinforce Zhang Xiu against Cao Cao's campaign.
text.zht: 劉表遣兵援助張繡，對抗曹操的征討。
text.zhs: 刘表遣兵援助张绣，对抗曹操的征讨。

text.en: After Li Tong praised Zhao Yan for impartially prosecuting Li Tong's own wife's uncle despite her pleas for mercy, the two became close friends.
text.zht: 趙儼秉公治罪李通妻伯父，不因其妻哀求而寬貸，李通反而讚賞其執法不阿，二人因此結為至交。
text.zhs: 赵俨秉公治罪李通妻伯父，不因其妻哀求而宽贷，李通反而赞赏其执法不阿，二人因此结为至交。

text.en: When Yuan Shao sent an envoy offering to appoint him General Who Conquers the South, Li Tong refused, executed the envoy, and sent the seal to Cao Cao instead.
text.zht: 袁紹遣使欲拜李通為征南將軍，李通拒絕，斬殺使者，並將印綬送予曹操。
text.zhs: 袁绍遣使欲拜李通为征南将军，李通拒绝，斩杀使者，并将印绶送予曹操。

text.en: Li Tong attacked and defeated the local rebel leaders Qu Gong, Jiang Gong, and Shen Cheng, sending their heads to Cao Cao.
text.zht: 李通擊破郡賊瞿恭、江宮、沈成等，將其首級送予曹操。
text.zhs: 李通击破郡贼瞿恭、江宫、沈成等，将其首级送予曹操。

text.en: Li Tong attacked and defeated the local rebel leaders Qu Gong, Jiang Gong, and Shen Cheng, sending their heads to Cao Cao.
text.zht: 李通擊破郡賊瞿恭、江宮、沈成等，將其首級送予曹操。
text.zhs: 李通击破郡贼瞿恭、江宫、沈成等，将其首级送予曹操。

text.en: Li Tong attacked and defeated the local rebel leaders Qu Gong, Jiang Gong, and Shen Cheng, sending their heads to Cao Cao.
text.zht: 李通擊破郡賊瞿恭、江宮、沈成等，將其首級送予曹操。
text.zhs: 李通击破郡贼瞿恭、江宫、沈成等，将其首级送予曹操。

text.en: Li Tong defeated the rebel Zhang Chi, who had gathered over five thousand households at Taoshan.
text.zht: 李通擊破聚眾桃山、擁眾五千餘家的賊人張赤。
text.zhs: 李通击破聚众桃山、拥众五千余家的贼人张赤。

text.en: When Guan Yu was dispatched to cut off the northern route during the siege of Jiangling, Li Tong led his troops against him, breaking through the encirclement to link up with Cao Ren.
text.zht: 關羽奉命於江陵之圍中截斷北道，李通率眾迎擊，突圍與曹仁軍會合。
text.zhs: 关羽奉命于江陵之围中截断北道，李通率众迎击，突围与曹仁军会合。

text.en: Li Tong broke through Liu Bei and Zhou Yu's encirclement to link up with Cao Ren's besieged army at Jiangling, his courage surpassing all other generals.
text.zht: 李通突破劉備、周瑜的包圍，與被圍於江陵的曹仁軍會合，其勇冠於諸將。
text.zhs: 李通突破刘备、周瑜的包围，与被围于江陵的曹仁军会合，其勇冠于诸将。

text.en: Li Ji was Li Tong's son, who inherited his title.
text.zht: 李基是李通之子，承襲其爵位。
text.zhs: 李基是李通之子，承袭其爵位。

text.en: Li Xu was Li Tong's elder son, who had formerly garrisoned Fancheng and also rendered meritorious service.
text.zht: 李緒是李通長子，曾屯守樊城，亦立有戰功。
text.zhs: 李绪是李通长子，曾屯守樊城，亦立有战功。

text.en: Li Xu was Li Ji's elder brother.
text.zht: 李緒是李基的兄長。
text.zhs: 李绪是李基的兄长。

text.en: Li Bing was Li Xu's son, a man of outstanding talent highly esteemed by his contemporaries, who rose to become Inspector of Qin Province.
text.zht: 李秉是李緒之子，才幹出眾，深受時人推重，官至秦州刺史。
text.zhs: 李秉是李绪之子，才干出众，深受时人推重，官至秦州刺史。

text.en: Li Bing attended Sima Zhao's court audiences, and long treasured an exchange in which Sima Zhao praised his reasoning on prudence and asked his views on the most prudent men of the age.
text.zht: 李秉侍從司馬昭朝會，曾與其論及審慎之道，司馬昭讚其所言有理，並問及當世最謹慎之人，李秉深以此事為訓。
text.zhs: 李秉侍从司马昭朝会，曾与其论及审慎之道，司马昭赞其所言有理，并问及当世最谨慎之人，李秉深以此事为训。

text.en: Li Chong, courtesy name Maozeng, was Li Bing's son; he became known while still young, serving as Personnel Division Gentleman and Grand Administrator of Pingyang.
text.zht: 李重字茂曾，是李秉之子，年輕即知名，歷任吏部郎、平陽太守。
text.zhs: 李重字茂曾，是李秉之子，年轻即知名，历任吏部郎、平阳太守。

text.en: When Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, sought to appoint the ailing Li Chong as Major on the Right, Li Chong, realising Sima Lun intended to rebel, tried to refuse; Sima Lun's unrelenting pressure to accept the post led directly to Li Chong's death days later.
text.zht: 趙王司馬倫欲拜抱病的李重為右軍將軍，李重察其有反意，力辭不受；司馬倫逼迫不已，李重被迫受任，數日後即去世。
text.zhs: 赵王司马伦欲拜抱病的李重为右军将军，李重察其有反意，力辞不受；司马伦逼迫不已，李重被迫受任，数日后即去世。

text.en: Li Shang, courtesy name Maozhong, was Li Chong's younger brother, and served as a commandery Administrator during the Yongjia era.
text.zht: 李尚字茂仲，是李重之弟，永嘉年間任郡太守。
text.zhs: 李尚字茂仲，是李重之弟，永嘉年间任郡太守。

text.en: Li Ju, courtesy name Maoyue, was Li Chong's younger brother, and eventually rose to become Inspector of Jiangzhou.
text.zht: 李矩字茂約，是李重之弟，後官至江州刺史。
text.zhs: 李矩字茂约，是李重之弟，后官至江州刺史。

text.en: Li Shi, courtesy name Jingze, was Li Chong's son, whose highest office was Palace Attendant.
text.zht: 李式字景則，是李重之子，官至侍中。
text.zhs: 李式字景则，是李重之子，官至侍中。
